name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9.6-dev.5 (dev build for Osama): 0.9.6-dev.4 plus the PLA ZTZ-98 (Shawn's model, new camo and material layer) and the ZBD-04 in the PLARF Rocket Conscript Force, and the queued Lateralus infantry fixes (Thermobaric Assault, Combat Engineers, Taishan Eagles, Whistling Arrows), the Lateralus title-screen fix and the new Ranked card art. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.80.
